g.text: Left: Herdr hierarchy. Middle: how Yochi shows each level. Right: the home page.
Remote Spaces show the machine name
In no Space → "Other terminals", per machine
A named Tab goes on line 3: repo · worktree · Tab
Also replaces a generic Agent title
Session page menu: "Terminals in this Tab"
Agents first, pinned on top, sub-agents indented
Needs you → top of list, across Hosts and Spaces
Rows also stay in their own group
GUI / TUI → set by launch command
claude → conversation page (GUI); else → terminal page (TUI)
Fixed at launch, not by what runs later
A collapsed Space keeps its title
④ row order = pane order ③ Tab name on line 3 ① machine name
